info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Sequoia Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Sequoia Battery Detail Creation API enables businesses to streamline the addition of detailed information about Sequoia battery models into their catalog. Through this endpoint, developers can submit comprehensive specifications and attributes of Sequoia batteries, ensuring accurate and updated listings. Typical consumers of this API include automotive retailers and battery manufacturers looking to manage their product offerings effectively. This API is essential for maintaining an organized database of battery details that can enhance customer information and support sales efforts.

post.summary: Create a new Sequoia Battery detail entry.
post.description: This operation allows users to create a new detail entry for a Sequoia Battery. Make sure to provide all required information in the request body to successfully add the detail.

requestBody.description: Contains the detailed information required to create or update the Sequoia battery configuration. Ensure that all relevant fields are accurately populated for successful processing.

200.description: The request was completed successfully and the details were retrieved.

CreateCatalogSequoiaBatteryDetailRequest.description: This schema defines the request body for creating a new Sequoia battery order. It includes details such as the battery ID, requester information, quantity, priority status, unit price, and supplier details.
